source.publisher: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
source.title: Kelp Canopy 2016 - California
source.credit_verbatim: Please cite the Originators in any reference to the data: California Department of Fish and Wildlife (contract & database management) and Sandoval & Associates, LLC (data collection and processing).
source.no_kelp_mapped_verbatim: An area where no kelp data are present may represent an area devoid of kelp, or may represent an area where kelp was not detected due to poor photo quality, missing photo coverage, or other issues with data collection and processing.

method.centre: The California Coastal Commission's own published coordinate for the entry point.
method.geometry: CDFW's full-resolution 2-metre survey polygons — not the generalized map layer — in CDFW's own California Teale Albers metres, an equal-area projection.
method.area: The area of CDFW's mapped kelp inside a 500-metre circle around the entry point, by CDFW's two classes, rounded to the square metre.
method.nearest: Straight-line metres from the entry point to the nearest kelp CDFW mapped in that survey, rounded to the metre.

absence_rule: A zero means CDFW's 2016 aerial survey mapped no kelp inside the circle. It is not a statement that no kelp grows there now; in CDFW's own words: "An area where no kelp data are present may represent an area devoid of kelp, or may represent an area where kelp was not detected due to poor photo quality, missing photo coverage, or other issues with data collection and processing."
